article.story: CHARLOTTE, N.C. -- — Nasir Mann scored 23 points as Queens beat South Carolina State 102-78 on Friday. Mann had six rebounds and six assists for the Royals (5-5). Carson Schwieger scored 17 points and added six rebounds. Yoav Berman shot 5 for 9 (1 for 5 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points, while adding three steals. Obie Bronston Jr. finished with 17 points for the Bulldogs (0-11). Chris Parker added 10 points and 20 rebounds for South Carolina State. Jayden Johnson finished with 10 points and 11 assists. The Bulldogs prolonged their losing streak to 11 straight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
